secrets.name: SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN
secrets.description: Shopify store domain (e.g. your-store.myshopify.com) from Shopify Admin > Settings > Domains

secrets.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Shopify Dev Dashboard app Client ID — App settings > Credentials

secrets.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Shopify Dev Dashboard app Client Secret — App settings > Credentials

secrets.name: DELHIVERY_API_TOKEN
secrets.description: Delhivery B2C API token from the Delhivery client dashboard

secrets.name: DELHIVERY_PICKUP_LOCATION
secrets.description: Registered warehouse/pickup-location name in Delhivery (case and space sensitive)

secrets.name: KWIKENAGE_API_KEY
secrets.description: KwiKenage WhatsApp API key from the KwiKenage dashboard

secrets.name: KWIKENAGE_SENDER_PHONE
secrets.description: KwiKenage sender phone number in E.164 format (e.g. 919999999999)
